items.title: Show HN: Freqcast, an Android radio player that finds streams from a website URL
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN!
Not every internet radio station is listed in a directory like Radio Browser. For a lot of them, the only way to actually listen is to dig the stream URL (.mp3/.aac/.m3u8) out of the station's website by hand — and that's before you even find a player that isn't full of ads or locked to its own catalog.
